create_dataflow_graph: create a dataflow graph using model_opt dataflow_graph Graph class
add_node_to_graph: add a node with a name, size, and read_only flag to the graph
add_edge_between_nodes: add an edge between source and sink nodes with a specified size and name
canonicalize_graph: canonicalize the graph to convert MultiSourceEdge instances into single-source Edge instances
build_graph_with_constants: build a dataflow graph that includes constant nodes with read_only attributes
